methodology.monthlyReturn: 2026-07-31 adjusted close / latest adjusted close on or before 2026-06-30 - 1
methodology.realizedVolatility: July daily log-return sample standard deviation annualized by sqrt(252)
methodology.maxDrawdown: Close-to-close drawdown from the running peak, including the 2026-06-30 baseline
methodology.augustSeasonality: Each August month-end adjusted-close return from the prior July month-end; max drawdown uses daily closes
